description: This file defines a utility class HeaderWriter that inserts a header comment into generated Java source files, including a timestamp and a notice that the file is auto-generated.

classes.name: HeaderWriter
classes.description: Utility class for inserting header comments into generated code files.

methods.name: appendHeader
methods.description: Inserts the header text into the provided output stream, including a generated timestamp.

methods.name: headerToString
methods.description: Returns the header content as a string.

methods.name: loadHeader
methods.description: Loads header content from the header.txt resource and applies macro replacements.
